topic_en: Visualize how Taylor series approximates sine of x near x equals zero. First, plot the true sine curve in blue. Second, plot the first-order approximation T one of x equals x in yellow and show it only matches near the origin. Third, add the third-order approximation T three of x equals x minus x cubed over six in green, showing improved accuracy. Fourth, add the fifth-order approximation in orange. Fifth, add the seventh-order approximation in red, which matches sine over a much wider range. Each new approximation should appear as a new curve overlaid on the same axes, with a legend showing the order. Conclude that higher-order Taylor polynomials match the function over a wider interval.
topic_zh: 用泰勒級數的前 1、3、5、7 階逼近 sin(x)，視覺化逼近過程
code_preview:
from manim import *


class MainScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # ---------- Title ----------
        title = Text("Taylor Series Approximation of sin(x)", font_size=40)
        title.to_edge(UP)
        self.play(Write(title))
        self.wait(0.5)

        # ---------- Axes ----------
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-PI - 0.5, PI + 0.5, PI / 2],
            y_range=[-3, 3, 1],
            x_length=10,
            y_length=5,
            axis_config={"include_tip": True, "color": GREY_B},
            tips=True,
        ).shift(DOWN * 0.4)
